description: Metric-units user asks about their easy pace. All pace guidance must be in min/km, not min/mi. Distance must be in km.

user.name: Lena
user.notes: British runner, training in km. Goal is sub-1:45 half marathon.

inbound_sms: What pace should I be running my easy runs at?

ground_truth.notes: Lena has preferred_units: metric. She asked about easy pace. VDOT 50 easy pace is 8:45/mi = 5:26/km. The system-computed range (Jack Daniels / route.ts formula) is 5:25–5:55/km. Response MUST give pace in min/km (around 5:25-5:55/km range), NOT min/mi. Must NOT say '8:45 per mile' or '/mi' anywhere. Distance references should use km (e.g. '13km long run' not '8-mile long run').
